agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ARTS COMMISSION

  ARTS COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
  September 21, 2022  6:30 p.m.
  Via Zoom
  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS
Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing
measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-
29-20 ((https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp- content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-
EO.pdf)), please note that members of the public will only be allowed to observe
and address the Arts Commission Meeting of September 21, 2022 at 6:30 P.M.
by telephone or video as follows:

Members of the public who wish to listen, view and or orally address the Arts
Commission must use the public access options noted below:

Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
   Members of the public may view, listen and make oral public comments
  telephonically by:

  View, Listen and Comments

  Visit zoom.us/join.  Meeting ID: 856 1256 8463  Passcode: 540804

  Listen only and Comments

  One tap mobile - +16699006833,, 85612568463#,,,,

Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

    When you log-in/call-in, except for meeting presenters and speakers, all
  microphones and video cameras will be muted/off.
    When you are making public comments, you line will be unmuted.

  Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit comments for
  consideration by the Arts Commission by sending them to Stephanie Maldondado,
  Senior Management Assistant, at smaldonado@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Arts Commission prior to consideration of the
  agenda, comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on September 21, 2022,
  the day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and
  agenda item. Comments received after 12:00 P.M. will be made part of the official
  public record of the meeting.

[Agenda Items and Additional Public Access Options Listed on Following
Pages
   CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ARTS COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
  September 21, 2022  6:30 p.m.
  Via Zoom - Meeting ID: 856 1256 8463 Passcode: 540804

  I.  Opening
  a. Call to order
  b. Salute to the flag
  c. Roll Call

  II.  Public Comments – Agenda Items Only

 III.  Approval of Minutes – July 20, 2022

 IV.  Staff Reports
  a. Staff report recommending the Arts Commission recommend the City Manager
  approve a creative services agreement between the City of Inglewood and Pontus
  Willfors in an amount not to exceed $30,000 for the Inglewood Growing Artists
  Projects 2022: Art of the Trees; and Designate James Dinh/Studio Folia as the
  alternate. PDF

  b. Staff report recommending the Arts Commission recommend the City Manager
  approve an agreement with art conservators Sculpture Conservation Studio of
  Constantinople (SCS) in an amount not to exceed $15,723.46 to reinforce and
  repair the History of Transportation Art Monolith at Grevillea Art Park. PDF

  V.  Verbal Reports Regarding the following Public Art Related Projects
  a. Art and Culture Walking Tour Series: Open + Green Spaces, Beach Avenue +
  Beyond and Entertainment + Sports tours
  b. Mural conservation and sacrificial coating applications for Parks Make Life Better
  and Pathways to Success

 VI.  Public Comments – Regarding Items Not On the Agenda

VII.  Commissioners’ Comments/ Initiatives / Art Calendar
  a. October is National Arts and Humanities Month
  b. October 22 at 2 p.m. - 50th Anniversary of Tom Van Sant’s public art, panel and
  reception at Waddingham Lecture Hall, Inglewood Public Library

VIII.  Adjournment - Next Arts Commission Meeting: October 19, 2022 at 6:30 p.m.

In the event that the Arts Commission meeting of September 21, 2022 is not held, agenda items will
automatically be continued to the next regular Arts Commission meeting. (Note: The above procedures are
subject to change for future Commission meetings. Please refer to future Arts Commission agendas for
public participation option procedures at that time.)
